info.name: Fleetsu - API
info.description:
Platform API Documentation

The Fleetsu API is organised around REST. Our REST URls return JSON-encoded responses. Standard HTTP Response codes are returned on all requests. Ensure a Header Value Key = "Accept" Value = "application/json"

All API Requests must be made over HTTPS

Authentication

The Fleetsu API uses HTTP Basic Authentication use your Fleetsu username and password to authenticate.

Unauthenticated requests will fail with a 401 Unauthorized HTTP Response

Basic Authentication

Using standard basic http authentication headers,using a user's login credentials e.g.

Authorization: Basic OgXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX==

Filtering/Searching

String Fields

Examples

  • ?label=Asset123 Specific Search
  • ?label=Asset* Wildcard Search
  • ?label=*123 Wildcard Search
  • ?label=Asset123,Asset456 Multivalue OR search

Integer,Float Fields

Examples

  • ?groupId=12 Specific Search
  • ?groupId=12,76,100 Multivalue OR search
  • ?groupId[0]=12&groupId[1]=76&groupId[2]=100 Multivalue OR search

Datetime Fields

Datetime fields can be searched using most common formats including relative, although it is recommended to use ISO 8601 standard dates.

If a timezone is not specified in the date string UTC will be assumed.

Examples

  • ?datetime=>2017-01-01T00:00:00Z
  • ?datetime=<2017-11-30T00:00:00+00:00
  • ?datetime=>2017-11-14T00:00:00+08:00,<2017-11-17T23:59:59+08:00
  • ?datetime=-7 day
  • ?datetime=>last monday midnight,<today midnight

Sorting

_sort - Sort Results Set by specifed field e.g.

  • _sort=label - Sort by label field in ascending order
  • _sort=!label - Sort by label field in decending order
  • _sort=make,model - Sort by Make and then Model in ascending order

Pagination

_limit - Limit returned results Min: 1, Max: 1000, default: 200

_start - Start point for returning results e.g. _start=201

Extending Datasets

_extend - Append related data to the search results e.g.

  • _extend=event - Single Extend
  • _extend=event,account - Multiple Extends

Basic Extend

The returned fields in the extended objects can also restricted to the fields you require e.g.

  • _extend=event:eventId|latitude|longitude|heading|speed|datetime

Advanced Extend

  • _extend[event][_fields]=eventId|latitude|longitude|heading|speed|datetime
  • _extend[event][datetime]=>2018-06-01,<2018-06-30
  • _extend[event][code]=144
  • _extend[event][_sort]=datetime

Grouping

_group - Group Results By Field e.g.

  • _group=datetime:hour Group By Hour

Available Datetime field modifiers

  • HOUR - Hour of Day
  • DATE - Day
  • MONTH - Month
  • DAYOFMONTH - Day of Month e.g. 1st of every month
  • DAYOFWEEK - Day of the Week
  • DAYOFYEAR - Day of Year 1 to 365
  • MINUTE - Minute
  • WEEK - Week of Year
  • WEEKDAY
  • WEEKOFYEAR
  • YEAR
  • YEARWEEK
  • DATEHOUR

Fields

Field Type Description

enabled integer An Integer indicating the current asset state 0 = Enabled, 4 = Paused

accountId integer Integer Identifying the account where the asset is assigned
groupId integer Integer Identifying the group where the asset is assigned
dateActivated datetime UTC Datetime when the asset TODO
vehicleMake string The Maker/Manufacturer of the asset
vehicleModel string The Model of the asset
vehicleRegistration string The Rego/Registration of the asset
vehicleVin string The Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) a unique serial number used by the automative industry to identify individual vehicles
maker string The Maker/Manufacturer of the Device used to capture Events and transmit to the platform
model string The Model of the Device used to capture Events and transmit to the platform
dateProvisioned datetime UTC Datetime when the asset TODO
subscription string Description
tripMethod string Description
dateInstalled datetime UTC Datetime when the asset TODO
allowApiEvents boolean Description
fuelTankSize integer Description

driverId integer Description

string Description
